segments.text: Hello and welcome to this module of an introduction to virus management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到生物风险管理导论的这一单元。

segments.text: Today we will be demonstrating to you on the usage of the PEPL.
segments.zh: 今天我们将向大家演示 PAPR 的使用方法。

segments.text: This is a powered air purified respirator which is designated as a PAPR.
segments.zh: 这是一种动力送风过滤式呼吸器，简称 PAPR。

segments.text: The PAPR consists of a helmet which is mounted with a filter which will filter out most pathogens.
segments.zh: PAPR 由一个头盔组成，头盔上装有过滤器，可以滤除大部分病原体。

segments.text: It also has a shroud and it is a self-continuing.
segments.zh: 它还带有一个头罩，并且是自给式的。

segments.text: Now the way in which this functions is that the air is pulled in through this side.
segments.zh: 它的工作原理是：空气从这一侧被吸进来，

segments.text: It passes through this filter and a fan will create a down drop on your face.
segments.zh: 经过这个过滤器，然后风扇会在你的面部形成向下的气流。

segments.text: Now these respirators need to be powered by a battery pack.
segments.zh: 这类呼吸器需要由电池组供电。

segments.text: So I will demonstrate the usage of this video.
segments.zh: 下面我来演示它的使用方法。

segments.text: Wearing a belt. This is the belt.
segments.zh: 先系上腰带。这就是腰带。

segments.text: You need to adjust this belt because once it is inside your direct suit.
segments.zh: 你需要调整好这条腰带，因为一旦它进入你的防护服里面，

segments.text: You will no longer have access to this belt module.
segments.zh: 你就再也够不到这个腰带组件了。

segments.text: The second one you need to know about is this battery.
segments.zh: 第二个你需要了解的是这块电池。

segments.text: This is a battery. So please ensure that your battery is recharged prior to each laboratory experiment.
segments.zh: 这是电池。所以请确保在每次实验室实验之前都给电池充好电。

segments.text: I am going to fit this on my belt.
segments.zh: 我要把它装到我的腰带上。

segments.text: Now if you notice the MaxA has a shroud.
segments.zh: 大家注意，MaxAir 带有一个头罩。

segments.text: This shroud can be recycled by basically decontaminating this.
segments.zh: 这个头罩基本上可以通过去污处理后重复使用。

segments.text: But it is also recommended in case of a spill.
segments.zh: 但也建议，如果发生溢洒，

segments.text: You need to replace this with another shroud.
segments.zh: 你需要换一个新的头罩。

segments.text: This is the wire and if you look inside you will see an adjustment for the headband.
segments.zh: 这是导线，如果你往里面看，会看到头带的调节装置。

segments.text: So once you have worn your high max suit. You have to wear this like this.
segments.zh: 所以在你穿好防护服之后，你要像这样把它戴上。

segments.text: So please ensure that you have fitted your power.
segments.zh: 所以请确保你已经接好了电源。

segments.text: Or else you will suffocate. I am going to turn on the power.
segments.zh: 否则你会窒息。我现在要打开电源。

segments.text: Now the power is on.
segments.zh: 现在电源已经打开了。

segments.text: And when the power is on you will see 3 lights here.
segments.zh: 电源打开时，你会看到这里有 3 个指示灯，

segments.text: Which is indicating power off.
segments.zh: 表示电源关闭。

segments.text: So this battery will last for around 6 hours.
segments.zh: 这块电池大约能用 6 个小时。

segments.text: After which you will have to recharge this battery.
segments.zh: 之后你就需要给电池充电。

segments.text: Ok so I am going to wear this now.
segments.zh: 好，我现在要把它戴上。

segments.text: Ok I have mounted this.
segments.zh: 好，我已经戴好了。

segments.text: You can see how it is worn.
segments.zh: 大家可以看到它是怎么戴的。

segments.text: That is how it looks all around.
segments.zh: 从各个角度看就是这个样子。

segments.text: And then you are done.
segments.zh: 然后就完成了。

segments.text: So this is the basic setup for the truck.
segments.zh: 这就是这套装置的基本佩戴方法。

segments.text: If you want to take it off.
segments.zh: 如果你要把它摘下来，

segments.text: Do it this way.
segments.zh: 就这样做。

segments.text: And you keep on running until it is off.
segments.zh: 然后一直转，直到它关掉为止。

segments.text: And then you disconnect the battery.
segments.zh: 然后断开电池。

segments.text: Ok generally after every biosafety procedure.
segments.zh: 好，一般来说，每次生物安全操作之后，

segments.text: This helmet will be decontaminated using a surface decont.
segments.zh: 这个头盔都要用表面去污剂进行去污。

segments.text: And in some cases we will change this route.
segments.zh: 在某些情况下，我们还会更换这个头罩。

segments.text: And after completion of your procedure.
segments.zh: 在你的操作完成之后，

segments.text: Please ensure that your battery is charged.
segments.zh: 请确保给电池充好电。

segments.text: Ok that is a brief introduction to the max air system which we use.
segments.zh: 好，以上就是对我们所用的 MaxAir 系统的简要介绍。

segments.text: It is a powered air purified respirator.
segments.zh: 它是一种动力送风过滤式呼吸器。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching.
segments.zh: 非常感谢收看。
